title: The Spear Hero’s Second Chance
text: I’ve turned a piece I posted last year on April Fools’ Day—with a few minor additions—into the first chapter. So, if you’re already familiar with it, feel free to skip this part.
“Motoyasu, do you like me or —- more!?”
“Eh… um… oh, my phone’s ringing. I’ll be right back!”
I shook off —-chan—who had just told me she liked me—and ran away from the scene.
“Oh, Motoyasu!”

After all, it was true that, to me, both you and she were girls I liked equally… so I still couldn’t make up my mind. I’m supposed to talk with —-chan at my house tonight. I… just can’t bring myself to fully dislike my friend —. It’s not like — meant any harm when he teased —-chan. It was just that everyone around us jumped to conclusions, and it turned into underhanded bullying. Besides, isn’t it only natural for guys to talk to girls and go out with them?
I want everyone to get along. Bullying is just pathetic. That’s why I thought I’d confronted the bullying head-on and resolved it. So why did things turn out like this?
I… should I date my friend — or the sheltered rich girl —?
My friend — The rich girl — ←

But I also want to be with my friend —. I’m a junior in college, and I’ve dated various girls my whole life, but I realize this is the most difficult relationship I’ve ever been in. Why are the girls around me right now such a hassle? Yet I keep agonizing over the fact that I can’t seem to break free.
I’ve been enjoying the online game I’ve played since high school. It was actually a girl who introduced me to online gaming… and I ended up getting even more hooked on it than she did.
“Is it selfish to just want to have fun with everyone…?”

The bad thing about my friend — is that, even though she’s outgoing, she can be pushy. She shows up at my place unannounced, like a “ghost wife,” and cleans the house… but she ends up throwing my stuff away without asking. Then, when I went to —’s room, I found the things she said she’d thrown away, and when I asked her about it, she said she’d taken them because it seemed like a waste. On the other hand, the “princess” — shows up wherever I go with a frequency that’s way too high to be a coincidence… It’s not that she… forces her ideals on me, but I feel like I’m being watched. After finishing my classes that day, I went on a date with a girl I’d picked up recently before heading home.
And then… when I got back to my apartment, I heard a commotion coming from inside.
“Why are you at Motoyasu’s place?!”
“That’s exactly what I’m asking! —-san!”
I heard the sound of something shattering. I hurriedly opened the door. There, the two of them were in the middle of a physical fight.
“—is rich, so even if it’s not Motoyasu, there are plenty of other guys out there! Just give it up!”
“Motoyasu-san is the only one I love! He’s my prince! You could never make Motoyasu-san happy!”
“Don’t just assume things on your own!”
“Both of you, stop it!”
I stepped in between them and pulled them apart.
“Motoyasu!?”
“Motoyasu!”
Now that they’d finally noticed I was there, they seemed to calm down.
“Please tell —- and Motoyasu too! That I’m the one dating Motoyasu.”
“That’s not true! I’m the one dating Motoyasu!”
Oh, for heaven’s sake! Why are these two always fighting? I can’t even take them on a group date with a bunch of girls! They need to get along equally well with everyone!
“Since we’re on the subject, I’ll just say this: I’m not ready to date just one person yet. I don’t even want to think about that.”
“But…”
―― was speechless and took a few steps back. Her eyes widened as if she’d lost her temper—but in that split second, she grabbed a kitchen knife from the kitchen.
“What are you trying to do? Stop it!”
“It’s Motoyasu’s fault! He’s the one who made me like this! So—”
And with that, — dashed toward — with the kitchen knife. Determined not to let her do it, I braced myself to wrestle the knife away from her—but then I felt something pierce my side.
“Eh…”
When I turned around, —-san was holding the knife pressed against my side. Along with a sharp pain, an unbelievably red liquid began gushing from my body.

“Ahaha… You were on a date with a girl just a moment ago, weren’t you? I know. Rather than let —-san or anyone else take you, I’ll kill you and die myself. We’ll be together in heaven! Ahahahahahaha!”
—-san pulled the knife out with a squelching sound, like a broken doll.

The wound felt hot, and I could feel my strength gradually draining away. On impulse, I called out to ―― for help. She snapped out of her stunned expression and rushed over to me. Then, with a thud, she plunged a kitchen knife into my chest.

I let out a scream that wouldn’t come out as a sound. I trembled uncontrollably, and blood gushed out in a torrent. I could feel the heat escaping from the depths of my body; even though I was burning up, I could feel myself growing colder and colder.
“I’m the one who’s going to be with Motoyasu in heaven! You can just die there on your own and go to hell!”
“You’re the one who’s going to hell!”
“Oh, really? I’m the one who killed Motoyasu, aren’t I?”
“He’s still alive! Motoyasu, please wait for me. I’ll put you out of your misery right now.”
And then—san aimed the knife at my throat—.
“I won’t let you get in my way! I’m the one who’s going to be with Motoyasu!”
“Do you really think you can beat me!?”
The two of them, blades in hand, continued their fight. I pressed my hand to my trembling chest and reached out into the void with blurred vision.
Am I—going to die? Why… why did it have to come to this? I… just wanted everyone to get along and have fun! I should have trusted all the girls equally… That’s right.

The one I know… wouldn’t do something like this—and she should be a kinder person, too. I just couldn’t bring myself to believe in the love they both felt for me. That’s why I should’ve told them properly. I have plenty of girlfriends. They all trust me, and I trust them. So I wanted to tell you both to trust each other and live happily.
I failed. I failed. I failed…
If—if there’s a next time, I’ll believe. Since all girls are angels, it’s my fault for not earning their trust.
Is this… what happened before I went to the world I thought was my “Emerald Online”…?
A long time has passed since then.
My name is Motoyasu Kitamura. I’m the Spear Hero who swore to protect Filo-tan and Filolial—the one destined to save the world. But—.
“Guhhhhhhh!?”

My HP dropped to zero, and a hole was torn right through my chest. I tried to look at my opponent’s face, but I couldn’t—my vision blurred… and I began to lose consciousness. Ah… this is the second time I’ve died, but it’s never a pleasant experience, no matter how many times it happens. Come to think of it, why was I so infatuated with that self-centered pig?

Come to think of it, the reason I came to this world was because that pig stabbed me. Back then, I… well, I had two girls I liked, but I kept agonizing over my indecisive attitude. Maybe my behavior annoyed her, because one of the girls I liked started viciously bullying the other, and when I stepped in to save her, the girl I’d saved wanted me all to herself… In the end, those two selfish girls came at me together with knives, trying to force a double suicide.
Which one stabbed me to death first? I’ve forgotten. That pig. I can’t even remember her face anymore.
But more importantly, Filo-tan.

That angel is amazing. She came to the world of a game I knew, and when I—naively—was trying to build a harem with casual relationships with women this time around, she dealt me a iron-fisted punishment to set me straight. The way she’d always come barreling at me and knock me aside whenever I was walking with a girl—that was all because she cared about me, wasn’t it!

In the end, neither my gaming knowledge nor my experience with women was much use, but meeting Filo-tan truly gave my life a new lease on life! That fucking Bitch tricked my Father, and I—who knew nothing—was manipulated into turning against him. Eventually, my Father raised Filo-tan… and I had my fated encounter.

A lot happened after that, too. Because of my mistake, I broke the seal on the Spirit Tortoise and threw the world into chaos. Unaware that I was being deceived, I chased after those running pigs, trying my best. And then… when I found out I was just a clown, Filo-tan encouraged me when I was feeling down!
“Cheer up!”
I’ll never forget the look on her face back then. I fought because I wanted to save the world for Filo-tan and Filolial. If that were the end of it… no matter what the outcome, I’d have no regrets.
Saying that… well, I think that’s… just a little bit of a lie. I want to see Filo-tan’s smile some more. I want to be with Filolial. I don’t want to die!
“Oh…”
When I looked ahead, I saw men in robes staring at us in astonishment.
“What is it?”
“Huh?”

I’m not sure whose voice it was, but it was probably Ren’s. Is this a dream? The scene before me is exactly the same as the one I saw when I was first summoned to this world. A magic circle has formed below us, and it looks as if we’ve just been summoned.
“Where am I?”
Ren is speaking to the castle’s wizard. This is a memory from that day… I see. It feels nostalgic. The day it all began.
“Oh, Heroes! Please save this world!”
My Father, Ren, and Itsuki all said it together. Right, right—I said the same thing along with them, didn’t I…? It’s a strangely realistic flashback.
Let’s check my stats just to be sure.
…They’re basically the same as before… Huh? They’re higher than I remembered. So, what’s this spear I’m holding?
Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass 0/300 LR Ability Unlocked… Equipment Bonus: Ability “Time Reversal” Special Effect: Branching Worlds
What’s with this spear? I open the Weapon Book to check. Most of the spears listed are ones I recognize. But there are some I don’t… though it doesn’t look like I can switch them out.

What’s going on? The level is higher than I remember—what’s happening here? And what’s this “Time Reversal” equipment bonus for this spear, anyway? I learned from my Father that my knowledge of the game isn’t exactly helpful… Huh?　Did I really learn that? I can’t quite remember.
Um… I can remember up to the point where Filo-tan encouraged me, but after that, it’s as if a fog has settled over my memory—I can’t recall a thing. But there’s one thing I do remember.
This overflowing love I have for Filo-tan and Filolial!
I don’t know if this is a dream or if I’ve traveled back in time thanks to some lucky ability, but there’s only one thing I can do: fight for the world!
“Hm?”
Ren and Itsuki are looking at me. And then…
“Just how much of our intentions are you going to take into account?”
“Depending on what you say, we might end up becoming enemies of the world. Please be prepared for that.”
Ren and Itsuki both repeated the exact words I had said. My Father looks like he’s just lost a bet.
“Well, first of all, I’d like you to have an audience with the king. We’ll discuss your reward at that time.”
The head wizard of the castle had the door opened and was about to show us in.
“…I guess I have no choice.”
“Exactly.”
“Come on, let’s go.”
I held out my hand to my Father.
“Ah, ah.”

Somehow, Father’s face looked brighter—or rather, more childlike—than I remembered. Innocent, that’s the feeling. If I asked him to give me his daughter right now, would he? …Wait a minute. If I really did travel back in time, my Father hasn’t even raised Filo-tan yet, has he!? Just as I was thinking this, we were led into the throne room. Oh, there’s that Trash.
“Hmm, so these are the ancient heroes, are they?”
He’s staring at us intently. What an outrageous old fogey. I can’t even imagine how much my Father must have suffered at the hands of this guy…
“I am the king of this realm, Aultcray Melromarc the 32nd. Lift your heads, heroes.”

Ah, come to think of it, that was his name. I’d completely forgotten. What was I thinking at that moment? I remember thinking something like “Yay!” about traveling to another world, and getting even more hyped once I learned about the system. Then I was supposed to explain the “Wave,” right? Actually, the Wave is… Huh? I can’t remember. That’s strange—I distinctly remember it being a very important issue. Is this a side effect of time travel? Probably—no doubt about it. Memories of my dates with Filo-tan are fading in places!?

“True, I don’t really have any obligation to help them. It’d be a real pain to work for free only to be told ‘goodbye’ once peace is restored. Actually, I want to ask if there’s a way to get back—what’s the deal with that?”
“Grr…”

Father’s voice snapped me back to reality. I’d been lost in thought and hadn’t been listening. This isn’t the time for that anyway, and since I do remember this part, I should be fine—I hope. More importantly, the memories of Filo-tan that I was supposed to take to my grave have vanished. How can I remember them? Hmm? Come to think of it, instead of trying to remember, I should just create new memories. I’m a genius.
“Hey…”
My father gave me a light nudge with his elbow.
“Huh? What?”
“Oh, just introducing yourself.”
“Ah, my name is Motoyasu Kitamura, and I’m twenty…”
How old was I again? Wait, physically speaking, am I twenty-one now?
“Twenty?”
“No, twenty-one.”
“And your occupation?”
“I’m The Love Hunter.”
“Huh?”
I’ve already cast aside that boring title of “Spear Hero” because I’m fighting to win Filo-tan’s heart.
“He’s probably unemployed,”
Itsuki added. Well, say whatever you want. My days with Filo-tan, fueled by my love, can’t be defined by a job.
“Hmm… Ren, Motoyasu, and Itsuki, huh?”
“Don’t you dare forget my name, Father!!!!!!!”
“Huh!?”
Of all things, to forget my father’s name! Come to think of it, this Trash was the father of that pig, wasn’t he! I’ll teach him a lesson.
“Father!?”

My father cried out in surprise. Damn it. Saying something like that in this situation will just make him suspicious. First impressions are everything. I need to make sure he has a good impression of me—otherwise, he won’t let Filo-tan marry me.
“Ah, sorry. You look exactly like my special someone’s Father, so I just blurted it out.”
“H-huh… Do I really look that old?”
“No, no—you look almost exactly the same, so you’re young.”
“How old is the girl you like!?”
“I think…”
How old was she again? I’m totally vague on Filo-tan’s age…
“She hasn’t been born yet.”
“…You’re something else, aren’t you?”
“Is that so? Father.”
“Are you going to call me that? Could you please stop, if possible?”
“Heroes, please keep your private conversations to a minimum.”
A rather inconspicuous minister calls us out. Oh right, this Trash keeps forgetting my Father’s name.
“Well, let’s get back to the main topic. Your Father’s—”
“Um, Kitamura-kun. Please stop calling him ‘Father.’”
“Understood. I’d like you to correct your intentional omission of Naofumi-kun’s name.”
“‘Intentional?’”
“Yeah, this Trash thinks this country treats the Shield Hero—”
“Waaaaaaah! I’m so sorry. It was my fault, Spear Hero. Please calm your anger.”
Hmm… It seems even Trash is showing some remorse. The authority of the Four Holy Heroes is still quite potent.
“Calling the King ‘Trash’? Who do you think you are?”
Ren asks me warily. Hmm? Did I say something strange? I thought this guy’s name was Trash… …Ah, come to think of it, he did have a proper name to begin with.
“I’m The Love Hunter.”
I feel like Ren’s gaze just turned cold. Did I say something weird?
“Hmm… I’ve gone off on a tangent, but everyone, please check your stats and take an objective look at yourselves.”
“Huh?”
Why bring that up now…? I already checked my stats. They’re exactly the same. It’s like a ‘New Game Plus’! This is way too easy. The first wave is so weak there’s nothing to do.
“Um, how do we check them?”
“What’s wrong with you guys? Didn’t you notice this right after arriving in this world?”
Ren, looking like the go-to expert, starts to give a run-of-the-mill explanation. Alright, this is my chance to impress my Father!
“Wha—”
“Don’t you see an icon somewhere in the corner of your vision? Try focusing your attention on it.”
“Huh?”
Ren’s totally dumbfounded that I beat him to it. What a total goofball.
“Level 1, huh… That’s a little worrisome.”
“I mean, what even is this?”
“It doesn’t exist in the Hero’s world, does it? This is Status Magic—something anyone in this world can use.”
“Is that so?”
I guess even my father had a time like this. The Father I know has a sharp gaze, a sharp tongue, and a short fuse, but it’s nice that he seems open to reason.
“So, what are we supposed to do? You’re right—this level is a bit worrying.”
“Hmm. We’d like you, the Heroes, to set out on an adventure, hone your skills, and strengthen your Legendary Weapons.”
“Strengthen them? Aren’t the weapons we’re holding already strong to begin with?”
“Yes. According to legend, summoned heroes are meant to nurture and strengthen the Legendary Weapons they possess.”
When I stayed silent, my Father fell into a troubled silence before speaking up.
“Even if you call it a Legendary Weapon, I’ve got a shield. Wouldn’t it be better to use a sword?”
Ah, he doesn’t know.
“It doesn’t seem to work that way. The thing is, you can’t equip any other weapon while you’re wielding this Legendary Weapon.”
“Whoa!? Is that really true?”
“That’s right, so… Naofumi, you’d better rely on your party members.”
“Does that mean the four of us are forming a party?”
“That won’t work either.”
“Huh?”
“The Hero’s weapon will repel them, so they won’t gain any EXP. You can share the materials used to level up the weapon, though.”
“Please wait a moment—”
“Hm?”
Interrupted by me, the Minister fell silent.
“You seem strangely well-informed, Motoyasu-san.”
Itsuki looked at me with a puzzled expression.
“Ah, I’m from the future.”
“…I see.”
He believed me without a second thought. Everyone’s so kind these days.
“So, what were we talking about?”
He asked the Minister. Didn’t he hear what I said? It seems he didn’t believe me.
“Well, what the Spear Hero said is more or less correct. Apparently, having two Heroes together hinders their growth.”
My Father seems to be browsing the system. He’s probably reading the help section.
“It seems to be true… In that case, should I recruit some companions?”

“I’ll take care of finding you some companions. After all, the sun is already setting. Hero, you should rest well tonight and set out tomorrow. I’ll gather some promising candidates who might join you by then.”
Hmm… I can see a scheme brewing. I absolutely have to be careful.
“Thank you.”
“Thanks.”
“To the Shield Hero—”
“I know! I’ll gather them! I’ll definitely gather people who’ll join us!”
That Trash tells me to shut up. Well, I guess it’ll be okay?

In the guest room’s luxurious bed, everyone except me was staring intently at their weapons while listening to the explanation. It’s pretty ironic that all these guys, whose hearts are racing with anticipation… are going to end up going through such hell. Father will be next pretty soon.
“Hey, this is kind of like a video game, isn’t it?”
“It does seem like a game, but it’s a little different—”
“This world is the world of a console game.”
“That’s not right. It’s a VRMMO.”
“Huh? VRMMO—as in Virtual Reality MMO? Isn’t that something from the future?”
“What the—!? What are you even talking about?”
“Hold on, hold on.”
I stepped in to cut off everyone’s discussion. We should’ve already reached a conclusion.
“Rin, Itsuki, and Naofumi. Listen carefully.”
“W-what is it?”
“Everyone here comes from completely different worlds. Even within Japan, they’re totally different. Just keep that in mind.”
“I-is that so?”
“Yeah, I’m pretty sure Itsuki’s world is…”

Huh? There was supposed to be something about Itsuki’s world that was different from both the world I know and my Father’s world. Elements that Itsuki himself isn’t aware of—which makes sense, of course—but seem strange to us…
“My world is… what?”
“I forgot.”
“Wait, you’ve been strangely detailed about this since a little while ago—what’s going on?”
“I told you, didn’t I? I’m from the future.”
“Ah, yeah, yeah.”
I got swept along by Ren.
“Still, there’s some truth to what this self-proclaimed time traveler says. Let’s try to piece the information together.”

My Father and the others ignored what I said and started drawing their own conclusions on their own. Hmm… They don’t believe me? This is disheartening. So they don’t believe in knowledge from the future, huh? I just got transported to another world—you’d think they’d at least believe in supernatural phenomena like that. But I’ll let my Father know anyway.
“I’ll stay up all night to teach Naofumi-kun, who doesn’t know anything.”
“Ah, thank you… You’re so kind, Motoyasu Kitamura.”
“You’re welcome, you’re welcome. Please just call me Motoyasu. In return, I’ll call Naofumi-kun ‘Father.’”
“Please, stop it!”
He rejected me with a look of utter disgust. Hmm, does that reaction mean I messed up?

“Trusting in a hero’s weapon is part of what makes it powerful. You can get stronger by learning how I, Ren, and Itsuki have enhanced ourselves. Ren and Itsuki might say their classes have weak shields, but don’t worry—they’re incredibly strong. They have stats on par with ours.”
That’s right. Back then, everyone’s hearts were scattered, so we ended up putting a burden on my Father, but now we should be able to start over.
“Ren and Itsuki, listen to me. The knowledge I have might be different from what you all know. But by believing, the way to strengthen yourselves will become clear.”
“Ugh. Fine.”
“…Hmph.”
Their reactions are lukewarm. It seems they don’t trust me… How can I get them to believe me?
“Well, I guess I’ll go ahead and ask him.”
Just as I’d expect from my Father. No matter what, he’s always hungry for power. Just as I was about to start explaining…
“Hero, dinner is ready.”
We were called to dinner.
“Then I’ll explain after we eat.”
“Thank you.”
And so, I ended up staying up all night teaching my Father how to enhance this weapon.

As I was patiently explaining the enhancement method to my Father, he gradually drifted off to sleep. It seemed the sudden lecture had worn him out. After checking on Ren and Itsuki, who were already asleep, and making sure my Father was in bed, I set out for a nighttime stroll. The interior of the castle was just as I remembered… However, the view outside was slightly different.
The Spirit Tortoise Mountain was gone. This dreamlike moment felt far too long to be just a fleeting memory. Maybe… I really had traveled back in time.
If I’m here… maybe Filo-tan will agree to marry me! As I walked through the garden thinking that, I caught a whiff of Filolial! I followed the scent and discovered a shed where Filolials were kept.
“Gua!”
“Gua!”

It was late at night, so the Filolials seemed to be fast asleep. Ah, that scent. I can’t stand it anymore. Come to think of it, I haven’t smelled a Filolial in over half a day since arriving in this world. I’m starting to get withdrawal symptoms.
“Good evening~”
“Gua!?”
When I entered the Filolial enclosure to say hello, the Filolials woke up, startled. Then they looked at me with a somewhat wary expression.
“D-don’t be wary, Filolial-sama.”
“Gua?”
They aren’t making that “kue” sound… It seems they miss Filo-tan. But they’re Filolial-samas! I absolutely must replenish my Filolial fix.
“Here, here—I shall present you with your meal.”
I help myself to some dried meat from a nearby warehouse and present it to the Filolial-samas. Curious about the offering, they scramble to devour the dried meat I’ve brought.
“In return, may I give you all a good cuddle?”
They don’t seem to have been raised smart enough to understand human speech, but the Filolial-sama appear to be in a good mood.
“What a blessed joy.”
I touched the Filolial-sama, ran a comb through their feathers to my heart’s content, and breathed in their scent—and before I knew it, I was fast asleep alongside them.
“Doesn’t Kitamura-kun smell a little funny?”
The next morning, having woken up feeling refreshed, I met up with everyone.
“How rude to call it a ‘smell’—it’s the noble scent of Filolial-sama.”
“Filolial-sama?”
“Filolial-sama are Filolial-sama.”
“That’s not an explanation.”
“They are bird-like monsters that pull carriages,”
the minister acting as our guide added.
“Ah… those, right?”
My father-in-law nodded, as if he understood. After waiting a while, we were summoned.
“The Hero has arrived.”

When we reached the throne room, the pig and a group of men were waiting. About a dozen of them in total. For the sake of appearances, we all bowed our heads to Trash. I resented having to bow to Trash. But since Ren, Itsuki, and my Father were doing it, I had no choice but to follow suit.
“Regarding yesterday’s matter, I put out a call for those who wish to journey alongside the Hero. It seems you all have a Hero you’d like to accompany.”
I’m pretty sure the old me was hoping a girl would come to me. I don’t really care about that now. If anything, I’m worried about my Father. I’ve left him all alone.
“Now then, future heroes. Set out on your journey with the Hero you wish to serve.”
Ren, Itsuki, and my father look surprised. Oh, right—I was the one who was supposed to be chosen. The people who want to be my companions are gathering around me.
Ren: four. Itsuki: three. Me: three. My father: two.
“I’m one short here…”
My father voices his dissatisfaction. I’d think that’s a big improvement from the zero I had before, though.
“Ren, spare one for him.”

As soon as he says that, Ren’s companion? hides behind Ren like a shield. As for me, I’m stuck with nothing but pigs—it’s a real pain. Actually, there are so many pigs it’s gross enough to make me want to throw up.
“Oink!”
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink!”
I can’t make heads or tails of what they’re saying. Ugh… Father’s group has two pigs, too. There are just too many pigs—it’s a real problem.
“Naofumi-kun, if you don’t mind, I’ll give you three of mine.”
“Really!? But Kitamura-kun, if you do that, won’t you end up alone…?”
Just as you’d expect from the modest Father of Filo-tan. To think he’s even considering me…
“Hero, please refrain from swapping companions without permission.”
“Mmm…”
I’d really rather not go on an adventure with pigs.
“Now, here is your starting allowance. Heroes, be sure to accept this.”
Four pouches of gold were distributed in front of us. I heard a heavy, jingling sound. I’m pretty sure it was 600 silver coins.
I’m worried about the red pig standing next to my Father. Maybe it’s just my imagination, but I have a bad feeling about this.
“Each hero will receive 600 silver coins. Use them to gear up and set out on your journey!”
“‘Yes, sir!’”
I heard a “Oink!” sound! Hey, you!
So, after receiving the silver coins and preparing to set out on our journey, I tried to speak to my Father, but the pig cut me off.
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink.”
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink.”
I have absolutely no idea what it’s saying. Anyway, I need to step in and help my Father out…
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink”
“Get out of the way! Move it!”
I tried to push the pig aside to get closer to my Father, but the pig kept getting in the way. What a persistent pig. They’re not well-trained here in this country.
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink!”
“Um… Spear Hero? Isn’t that attitude a bit much toward your companion?”
A castle soldier called me out.
“I don’t care. He’s fired on the spot.”
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink!?”
“Oink-oink—shut up!”
“At least calm down, Spear Hero!”
“Let me go! I have something I need to tell my Father—”
While we were having this back-and-forth, Father had already left. After that, I was immediately summoned by the king and lectured on the importance of treating my companions with respect.
“Hmph. What right does this temporary king, in the absence of the real one, have to act so high and mighty?”
“Wha… You bastard, how much do you know!?”
“Get out of the way, you’re in my way!”

Ignoring the pig, I continued my search for my Father. In the end, between the soldiers getting in the way and that self-proclaimed “companion”—the pig—sticking to me like glue, nothing went right. I wonder where my father was and what he was doing that day. If I can’t find him, I’ll just give up for today.
That’s it! I’ll buy some Filolial.

I’ve got the money, so I’ll head to the Monster Merchant’s shop. I ran through the back alleys to lose them, and the pig and the soldiers were gone. I guess they didn’t expect a hero to be walking through the back alleys. They’re probably searching the main streets.
“Welcome. Hello.”
This looks familiar… Huh? Is it really familiar? I pop my head into the monster merchant’s men’s clothing shop. Was his side job a slave trader? He’s on good terms with my Father, isn’t he? This guy.
“You’re a first-time customer, aren’t you? What are you looking for in our shop?”
“Filo-tan.”
“Huh? Um, uh… Do you mean a Filolial?　Y-yes.”
“Filo-tan.”
I think my Father mentioned he’d gotten one at this shop before. Come to think of it, I should be able to become Filo-tan’s owner, too.
“I’m afraid we don’t have anything like that… Yes.”
“Um…”
It was Filo-tan, if I remember correctly.
“Sell me an Aria-type Filolial egg.”
“Sure, sure.”
“For 100 silver coins.”
I think I bought it for 100 silver coins… or did I? There’s a lot I don’t know about Filo-tan and my Father. I don’t know when I bought it.
“Understood. Then I’ll sell it to you.”
And what came out was… a pile of about 30 eggs. …Which one will become Filo-tan!?
“Which one turns cherry blossom pink when it hatches?”
Filo-tan was supposed to be cherry blossom pink at first.
“I’m afraid you won’t know until they hatch. Here…”
The monster merchant looks troubled. I’m going to make destiny work in my favor. A draw with all my might!
“This is it!”
I choose an egg based on intuition.
“Thank you very much. What should we do about registering the monster crest and the incubator?”
“For registration, all I need to do is drip some blood, right? Is the incubator sold separately?”
“Yes.”
“Got it.”

I paid 130 silver coins and bought the egg I thought was Filo-tan. If it turns out to be a dud… there’s no way I could sell Filolial-sama. I’ll keep buying until I hit the jackpot. I hardly need levels or weapon unlocks anyway, so for a while, I’ll earn some money and make Filo-tan.
Come to think of it, my father should be heading toward the grasslands. We’ll meet up there! That’s what I thought, anyway.
“Oink oink oink oink oink oink!”
“Oink oink!”
The pigs are making a racket. I get dragged into a tavern, where the bartender lectures me about recruiting companions.
“All I need for companions is a guy or a Filolial.”
“You… you’ve got women hanging around you, and that’s all you’ve got to say?”
“Surround myself? Are you talking about the pigs?”
“P-pigs!?”
For some reason, I got hassled by some adventurers at the tavern.
“Hey, you! Show some respect to women!”
“No matter what you say, a pig is a pig. I prefer men.”
“T-this guy. He’s good-looking, but he’s a homosexual!?”
“Don’t get the wrong idea! I like Filolials!”
“‘‘‘T-this guy’s a pervert—!!’‘’”
“Boo-boo!”
“What did you say!? The Spear Hero!? This guy?”
“That’s right. I’m fighting for the world.”
“Bullshit! A pervert like this!?”
“You don’t have to believe me. I’m saving the world for my Father, Filo-tan, and Filolial.”
“Who does this guy think he is!?”
“Don’t worry, I’ll save you guys too while I’m at it.”
“Don’t mess with us!”
And just like that, a bunch of adventurers came at me looking for a fight. I took them out in a second, and somehow it turned into a commotion. Oh, and just to be clear—I didn’t actually kill them.
“B-b-b-b-boo!”

Some guy with glasses is intently sketching me. I feel like I’ve seen him somewhere before… but where? While all that commotion was going on, night fell. Oh, and it wasn’t because I was getting into a brawl at the tavern—I was just looking for my Father when night fell.

I’d been keeping watch at the gate before sunset, but I never ran into him. If that red pig is him… then Father is in danger. After that, I wandered around looking for an inn, but the innkeeper wouldn’t tell me anything.
Damn… there are too many obstacles in the way. As a last resort, I’ll wait at the tavern where I ran into him.
“Oink!”
The red pig’s here! No doubt about it. That red pig is him! He’s even politely approaching me while carrying a chainmail shirt.
“Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink-oink?”
If I remember correctly…
“Huh? Isn’t that Lord Motoyasu standing over there?”
Was that it?
“Oink oink oink oink oink oink”
“If possible, please let me join you,”
he said cheerfully… or did he? After that, I got carried away and hit it off with him… and a little while later, after I handed over the chainmail, we stormed into the inn, didn’t we?
“Ah, well then, let’s talk for a bit.”
“Oink oink oink oink oink oink”
I can’t make out what he’s saying. I’ll just nod along to keep the conversation going. Eventually, the red pig tries to hand me the chainmail.
“That’s stolen goods, isn’t it? Give it back to the owner, Pig.”
“Bubub!? Bubububububu!?”
“I saw the evidence, so don’t even think about pinning this on Naofumi-kun!”
“Bwi! Bububububu!!!”

It’s totally losing it. I can’t make out what it’s saying, but this is the face a pig makes when it gets angry, isn’t it? I feel like I’ve seen it before. In the background of Filo-tan’s illustration.
“Well, I guess it’s about time to go to sleep.”
I refused the stolen goods and gave it a warning. That should take care of things. So, that night at the inn, I went to sleep while sniffing the scent of Filo-tan’s (planned) egg.
Early in the morning… I woke up and headed for the castle. …Because I had a bad feeling.
“Please wait, Spear Hero!”
“Get out of my way!”

Sure enough, Ren and Itsuki were gathered together, leaving me out. If my memory serves me right, they’re about to condemn my Father for a crime he didn’t commit. I kicked aside the soldiers standing in my way and entered the throne room. Perhaps realizing that such pointless obstruction would arouse suspicion among the other heroes, they seemed to stop blocking my path any further. There was Itsuki, clad in chain mail, standing with the red pig with his arms crossed… and another pig who was with my Father.
“W-well, Spear Hero, what brings you here so early in the morning?”
That Trash asked with feigned surprise… but I had other things on my mind.
“You…”
This pig… If I’m no good, then how about Itsuki?
“I heard about it, Motoyasu. I hear you called Myne a pig. What kind of person are you?”
“Who cares? To me, she looks like nothing but a pig, and all I hear is ‘oink, oink.’”
“That’s behavior unworthy of a hero!”
“Who cares? I don’t deserve to be condemned by an accomplice who wears stolen goods as if it were perfectly normal.”
“Stolen goods? What on earth are you talking about?”
“Are you playing dumb? The chainmail you’re wearing.”
“This is a gift from Myne-san.”
“That’s exactly why I’m saying it’s stolen.”
“Don’t make up nonsense. Do you have any proof?!”
“I do. The weapons and armor in this country are engraved with Magic—”
Just as we were having this conversation, my father arrived, dragging me away while I was still in my underwear. What a humiliation! I have to get him dressed right now!
“Myne!”
Trash, Itsuki, and Ren all glared at my father.
“W-what’s with that attitude?”
This scene leaves a bitter taste in my mouth. …This time, I won’t make a mistake.
“Do you really have no recollection of this?”
If I don’t do it, will Itsuki? If there were a dating sim from my Father’s perspective, this would be an unavoidable event, wouldn’t it?
“What do you mean, ‘no recollection’… Wait, ah!”
My Father pointed at Itsuki with a stunned expression.
“So you were the one who raided the pillow!”
“Who’s the pillow raider?! Naofumi-san. I never would’ve thought you were such a scoundrel!”
“Scoundrel? What are you talking about?”
“Wait—”
If I don’t stop this now, who will? I’m absolutely going to prove my Father’s innocence.
“Your Majesty, I—”
“And what are the charges against the Shield Hero?”
Guh… Is he planning to completely ignore me? Several soldiers step forward to block my view of my Father.
“Charges? What are you talking about?”
“Bubub… Bub… Bubububububu!”
“Huh?”
“Bububububububububu!”
I was completely fooled back then, but this is his modus operandi. You ugly sow!
“Bububububububububu!”
“Eh?”
“What are you talking about? After I finished eating yesterday, I was just sleeping in my room.”
“That’s a lie! Then why is Myne crying so much?!”
“Why are you defending Myne? And where’d you even get that chainmail?”
“From you—”
“Ah, yesterday, while we were all drinking, Myne stopped by the tavern. After we’d been drinking together for a while, she gave me this chainmail as a present.”
Looks like he never intended to let me speak from the start. If that’s how you want to play it, I’ve got a few tricks up my sleeve too.
“That’s right! Your Majesty! I, the Pillow Raider, had all my possessions—every piece of equipment except my shield—stolen while I was sleeping! Please catch the culprit!”
“Shut up, you Trash!”

You piece of trash… pulling off a scheme that was planned from the very beginning. …Should I kill him? No, doing that would put Father in a precarious position. His level is still low right now. I absolutely can’t let him die under any circumstances.
“Forcing sexual acts upon my unwilling subjects is an unforgivable atrocity—anyone who isn’t a hero would be executed on the spot!”
“I’ve been telling you it’s a misunderstanding! I didn’t do it!”
And then… Father’s expression darkens with rage.
“You! Don’t tell me you framed me for a crime I didn’t commit just to get your hands on the starting funds and equipment!”
“Hah! What are you talking about, you sex offender?”
“Don’t mess with me! You were after my money from the start, weren’t you? You planned this to get equipment for your whole group!”
“You’re such Trash—doing something like that to your comrades even after coming to another world.”
Ren coldly condemns Father. The soldiers are still blocking me, trying to keep me from speaking. But don’t think you can stop me with something like that.
“Get out of my way! Brionac!”
A beam of energy erupts, and I direct it at the soldiers blocking my path. Of course, I adjusted the power so they wouldn’t die—I fired it just hard enough to sweep them aside.
“‘Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!’”
Seeing the soldiers blown away, everyone present was speechless, and the area fell deathly silent. Seizing that opening, I brandished my spear and aimed it at Trash, Pig, and Itsuki.
“…Huh?”
“I believe in you, Father. You didn’t do this. This is a conspiracy.”
I explained the facts as they were to my father, who hadn’t fully grasped the situation yet, and glared fiercely at Trash.
“I suppose you plan to pull off quite a stunt while the tiger’s away, but if you so much as harm the Shield Hero, I, the Spear Hero, will not forgive you. Because that goes against love!”
I pointed my spear at the soldiers restraining my father and threatened them.
“Release the Shield Hero. If anyone gets in my way, I’ll show no mercy, no matter who it is!”
Next, I glared at Itsuki and Ren.
“That goes for you two as well. As you are now, you’re no match for me.”
Then, I held out my hand to my Father, who was now free, and said,
“I’ve come from the future to repay you for your kindness, Father.”
